title: Before & After
caption: A before-and-after photo shows one person's result under one set of conditions - lighting, angle, camera settings, and timing are rarely standardised. The 'after' is almost always taken at peak result, not six months later. What to actually look for: consistent lighting between shots, a realistic timeframe listed, and whether the starting point resembles yours. One well-read photo tells you more than a gallery of flattering ones. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
